title: Ansel and the Veil
author: J. M. Vane
blurb: Lena Zhou, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
